title: Invest.Rio e Maravalley vão levar 10 startups para o Web Summit Lisboa (Startups.com.br)
what_it_says: Invest.Rio (Rio city's investment agency) and the Maravalley hub take 10 Rio startups to Web Summit Lisboa 2026, second year; Daniel Barros (CEO, Maravalley) and Sidney Levy (president, Invest.Rio) quoted.
